protocol.outputs: 64 retained distinct output pairs per method; storage reused across graph replays
protocol.cache_scope: repeated static inputs and output buffers, no explicit cache flush
protocol.metric: Warm CUDA Graph GPU-event time per logical invocation, microseconds
protocol.aggregation: Median of eight within-process batch means; speedups are ratios of method medians
protocol.scope: Fresh post-selection timings of four fixed methods. No retuning; not ordinary Python-call or full-model latency.
protocol.worker_policy: One fresh sequential process per shape/dtype; cyclic order gives every method every position twice
